2155: A lot of Thai entertainment media reflects society well — though few people watch it for that.
A lot of Thai entertainment media avoids real issues altogether — it is mostly pure escapism.
A lot of Thai films reflect society well — it's not just entertainment for its own sake.
2156: A celebrity couple's caught up in a scandal right now — the whole internet is arguing about it.
A celebrity couple's caught up in a scandal right now — their sponsors have started pulling out.
A celebrity couple's caught up in a rumour right now — but neither has said a word.
2157: A celebrity who once slipped up can sometimes be forgiven so quickly nobody remembers it.
A celebrity who once slipped up can sometimes be criticised for years afterwards by total strangers.
A celebrity who once spoke out can sometimes be criticised so harshly they nearly have to quit altogether.
2158: Some films are controversial because their content offends religious groups.
Some films are controversial because of who paid for them.
Some films are controversial long before anyone has actually seen them.
2159: Thai TV tends to blur out images of cigarettes and tattoos — a form of censorship everyone's used to seeing.
Thai TV tends to blur out images of cigarettes and alcohol — though films in the cinema show both.
Thai TV tends to blur out brand names in every scene — a form of censorship everyone's used to seeing.
2160: These days a song doesn't need a big label to take off — social media does the work.
These days a song doesn't need a video to take off — it just has to click with listeners.
These days a song still needs a big label to take off — however good it is.
2161: So which do you reckon does it better these days — Thai series or Korean ones?
So which do you reckon sells more tickets these days — Thai films or foreign ones?
So which do you reckon our parents preferred — Thai films or Chinese ones?
2162: Children used to want to be teachers and doctors — these days, not so much; a lot of them want to be footballers instead.
Children used to want to be soldiers and nurses — these days, not so much; a lot of them want to be influencers instead.
Children used to want to be teachers and doctors — these days, even more so; hardly any of them want to be influencers.
2163: The media gradually shapes how we think without our noticing — about money, and about status.
The media gradually shapes how children speak without anyone noticing — about slang, and about accent.
The media gradually shapes how we think, and we mostly let it — about beauty especially.
2164: Many people take celebrities as role models — for how they speak and how they behave.
Many people take celebrities as role models — which worries a lot of parents.
Many people take celebrities less seriously than they used to — especially online.
2165: Many people feel close to the influencers they follow — as if they really know them, even though they've only met once. Funny, isn't it?
Many people feel close to the actors they watch — as if they really know them, even though they've never actually met. Funny, isn't it?
Many people feel close to the influencers they follow — then feel let down when the truth comes out, and it hurts. Sad, isn't it?
2166: If you scroll social media all day, you start to feel you are missing out — even though most of it is staged for the camera.
If you scroll social media all day, you stop noticing how much time has gone — even though you only sat down for a minute at the start.
If you scroll social media all evening, you start to sleep badly — even though you only meant to look at it for a minute or two.
2167: Most images on social media have been edited — leaving many young people unhappy with how they look.
Most images on social media have been edited — though the filters are getting easier to spot.
Most images on social media are taken on a phone — leaving many people with unrealistically high standards of beauty.
2168: Social media has its upsides too — it keeps families in touch across the world.
Social media has its upsides too — small businesses more or less live on it now.
Social media has its downsides too — it gives anyone a space to be cruel.
